spans.text: It's over.
Those words tumble around in your head as you stand in front of the entrance of the Live House, where people are milling about preparing for the event.
It's really all over this time.
You put down the phone. Sakura is still asking "What do we do?" anxiously on the other end.
Will Franchouchou really meet their end today?
You slump to the ground with a bitter chuckle. You check the time again—
There is half an hour before the performance officially begins.
Half an hour...
That's not enough for anything...
You unfold a map of Saga that you always have on you. You try to remain calm as you formulate a contingency plan.
Your finger first points at the convenience store.
Tae and Sakura are trapped in the storeroom there at the moment.
The original plan was for Sakura to collect Tae from her workplace and head to the performance venue together with her.
But life is unpredictable...
Commander! We... we're stuck in the storeroom!
Argh... Ugh... (She doesn't seem to be too aware of the current situation.)
I just wanted to help Tae finish moving the boxes more quickly...
But before I knew it, the door of the storeroom had been locked! Even Tae can't get the door open!
What do we do? What do we do?!
Sakura is running anxiously around the storeroom and Tae starts copying what she's doing. The two girls end up kicking up a micro dust storm in the storeroom...
Meanwhile, Saki is held up at the fast food restaurant.
She was just passing by on her motorbike. She was only ten minutes away from the performance venue.
But life is unpredictable...
I didn't ask for this! But they were having a really heated argument!
Nobody around tried to stop them. I was worried they would really have a go at each other, so I went up and tried to calm things down.
How would I know I'd get dragged into the whole thing?!
She just so happened to come across an intense argument between two local biking gangsters and quickly became embroiled in the dispute.
They're demanding a duel between me and their chief! I can't chicken out, can I?!
I can't talk right now. I'll be right there once I sort this out!
Saki hangs up decisively. Looks like she really means to take part in the duel.
Meanwhile, Yugiri and Lily are stumbling around the mansion in a panic.
They were supposed to go home, pick up their performance outfits, and make it back to the venue.
But life is unpredictable...
(Sobs) The outfits were right here!
Lily even double-checked before setting off for the rehearsal...
But they were gone when I came back to pick them up!
Don't cry, and don't panic. Let's look for them more carefully.
The outfits must be here somewhere...
But we've already combed the whole mansion seven times...
The performance outfits have vanished without a trace. They are currently seven feet deep into excavating the mansion.
Meanwhile, Ai and Junko are stuck in the dance studio.
They were supposed to run through all the blocking one last time before coming to the performance venue.
But life is unpredictable...
Commander! Is there any way you can have some foundation delivered here quickly?
I'm so sorry... I was so clumsy...
Junko slipped on some spilled makeup remover and ruined her makeup.
The dance studio just so happens to be really busy at the moment, so they dare not leave and show themselves.
You should go. Don't waste any more time here with me...
No! We're a team! We're not leaving anyone behind!
Now Ai must help Junko through the crowd and make it to the performance venue without being exposed as zombies.
You pull at your hair in frustration. You briefly consider just running into a wall, to hell with everything.
You don't have enough time to resolve any of the problems. What's worse, even if you do manage to get any one of them out of their predicament, the performance still won't be able to go ahead.
If that happens, Franchouchou's career will suffer a disastrous blow.
For Christ's sake...
You can already imagine the headlines in the coming days...
"What a Disgrace! Small-Time Band Franchouchou Putting On Airs and Bailing on Concert?!"
"Franchouchou in Shambles! What Were the Members Doing the Evening Before They Disbanded?"
"According to Witnesses, Franchouchou Members 3 and 4 Locked Themselves Up in the Dance Studio for a Night..."
No, no, no! This won't do!
I've got to think! I need to do something!
I've got to put things together!
Hey, what are you doing?!
You're pulled back from bashing your head against the wall.
Leave me alone!
Save your headbanging for later. Now go and get Franchouchou here for the interview. Gray Tree is done with theirs.
What's wrong? I thought we'd informed you about the interview beforehand?
There's been an accident...
Clashing numbers? Still putting on makeup? Problem with instruments? Sudden diarrhea?
No...
They're not stuck somewhere, are they? Hahahaha...
The production assistant's cheerful laughter slowly dies away.
You're not serious, are you?!
No...
Sheesh, you got me.
They're stuck in multiple locations.
You tell the production assistant about everything that happened after the rehearsal.
What?! The performance is less than 30 minutes away! They won't make it back here in time!
Don't just stand there! Move!!!
Where... should I go?
For some reason, the production assistant seems even more terrified than you. After doing high knees for 30 seconds, he tosses his assistant's writing pad at you.
I'll think of something! Try to buy some time!
What if they really don't make it?!
Have some faith in them! They WILL make it!
Just buy them some time! Delay the performance for as long as you can!
The backstage is in utter chaos because of Franchouchou's absence. You gather up your courage and walk up to the production manager.
It is down to you to buy enough time for Franchouchou to get here in time, so you have decided to...
Where is Franchouchou?
The production manager glares at you. He looks like he could start belching fire any second.
You smirk and cross your arm nonchalantly.
What's the rush? Don't you know big-time bands always show up fashionably late?
It's not metal enough to show up on time.
What's with your attitude?!
This isn't the first time I've organized a rock concert and I've never heard of such a ridiculous rule!
Well, now you have.
Why, you!
The production manager jumps up from his chair angrily, but you push him back down.
Franchouchou may have some popularity in Saga, but I'd hardly call them a big-time band!
They will be.
What?
Franchouchou will be a big-time band with international renown in the future.
Enthusiastic applause erupts in the auditorium. Looks like Gray Tree's performance is coming to an end very soon...
The furious production manager brushes you aside and walks toward the stage.
If Franchouchou still hasn't gotten here, I'll have to announce the cancellation of their performance.
Now, where is Franchouchou?
The production manager glares at you. He looks like he could start belching fire any second.
You point at the auditorium fearfully.
There's something more urgent compared to that!
What could be more urgent than a performing band not showing up on time?
I just overheard someone in the audience planning to attack Gray Tree with ketchup.
How's that possible? Our security checks are air-tight.
Better safe than sorry.
Gray Tree is a very popular band. If something happens to them, their manager will suck you dry.
The production manager raises his walkie-talkie with a frown.
Security, search the audience.
Copy that.
So when will Franchouchou be here?
Also, the spotlight rigged over the vocalist's head looks a bit precarious from this angle here!
Huh? It looks fine to me.
No, I swear I saw it wobble just now!
Stage Manager, get someone to check that spotlight up there.
On it.
So when will Franchouchou be here?
Also—
What now?! Stop changing the subject!
Enthusiastic applause erupts in the auditorium. Looks like Gray Tree's performance is coming to an end very soon...
If Franchouchou still hasn't gotten here, I'll have to announce the cancellation of their performance.
The project manager walks towards the stage without a backward glance...
Now, where is Franchouchou?
The furious production manager brushes you aside and walks toward the stage.
You take a large stride forward and grab hold of his thigh, then burst into tears.
What are you doing?!
Manager, please give us a bit more time!
They'll be here soon!
Soon? SOON?! Gray Tree started early to heat things up!
I'll give you five more minutes! If they still aren't here by then, they're gonna get cancelled everywhere!
(Sobs) My friend, things are very difficult for us!
Surely you must know how much hardship a small band like us have endured to get this far! We've been turned away and belittled so often!
But Franchouchou just grit their teeth and carry on, all just so they can perform in front of an audience...
That's none of my business! All I care about is whether this concert can go ahead smoothly. I'll kill whoever messes things up for me!
The production manager checks the time impatiently and starts walking toward the stage.
Time's up. I'll have to announce the cancellation of Franchouchou's performance.
Over my dead body! You'll have to kill me first!
You drop to the floor and roll in front of the production manager's feet.
Enthusiastic applause erupts in the auditorium. Looks like Gray Tree's performance is coming to an end very soon...
You hear that?! Gray Tree's performance is over! No one can buy any more time for Franchouchou!
I can! I can sing, rap, and play basketball!
Move aside!
You hang onto the production manager's leg for dear life. You can't stop him from moving, but at least you're slowing him down...
Now, where is Franchouchou?
The production manager glares at you. He looks like he could start belching fire any second.
You pat him on the shoulder calmly.
They're here.
Where? Tell them to get on stage already!
They're right here.
What?
Their spirit is like air. They're everywhere.
This is the true spirit of rock'n'roll!
Someone throw this lunatic out of here.
A few production assistants pin you down and start dragging you out of the backstage.
Enthusiastic applause erupts in the auditorium. Looks like Gray Tree's performance is coming to an end very soon...
Let go of me! I'm telling the truth!
If Franchouchou still hasn't gotten here, I'll have to announce the cancellation of their performance.
The project manager walks towards the stage without a backward glance...
Snap.
The moment Gray Tree is off the stage, it suddenly goes pitch black.
What's going on?
A few seconds later, the stage lights up again.
Franchouchou is now standing on stage, all members are present.
Huh, so that was all theatrics...
Indeed. Please do forgive me...
You let out a discreet sigh. They made it after all.
You observe Franchouchou on the backstage monitor, and you immediately notice...

Due to their hasty entrance, Sakura is holding a loudspeaker instead of a microphone; Junko is clearly wearing two different shades of foundation; Ai is already hyperventilating before the performance has even started; Saki is still wearing her biking gloves...
Only Lily, Yugiri, and Tae look relatively unruffled.
Hiss...
You inhale through your teeth as your heart leaps up to your throat.
The auditorium is covered in a frosty silence. Countless pairs of eyes stare coldly at Franchouchou.
You can't even begin to imagine the pressure they must be feeling.
It is the same pressure that Franchouchou has been feeling all along.
Hello everyone, we are Franchouchou!
We're so happy to be here!!!
No answer from the audience. Then comes the jeering.
What Franchouchou? We want Gray Tree!
You watch as Sakura tries to rein in her panic and raises her loudspeaker shakily—
The same loudspeaker that has accompanied her since Franchouchou's debut show, their first street performance, and the first quarrel.
She brings the loudspeaker closer to her face, inhales deeply, then—
She lets out all her pent-up rage in a deafening roar—
AAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!
The bellow smacks the audience in the face like howling wind, rubbing all of Franchouchou's anger, indignation, and tenacity into everyone's eyes and ears.
This isn't just a musical performance. It is a forced connection.
My god, what is this?!
How... how are they not breaking their necks with that kind of headbanging?!
FRANCHOUCHOUUUUUUU!!!
Not giving the audience any time to think, Sakura runs straight towards the auditorium and executes the first stage dive.
Stage diving?! Already?!
AAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!
Amid their frenzied headbanging, Franchouchou starts singing in an equally frenzied manner. The audience is soon swept away by their demented howls.
Cluck-cluck-cluck!!!
Gah... gah... gah!!!
A rooster's loud crow suddenly erupts in the center of the hysteria.
Is that... Drive-In Chicken?!
Drive-In Chicken flies over the audience on a wire and lands on the stage.
He picks up a broken electric cable on the ground and raises it as if he was pulling a sword out of a stone...
The next second, the backstage monitor goes black.
What was that?! What happened?! Why did it short out all of a sudden?!
While everyone around starts panicking in the dark, you smile serenely.
You know it is truly Franchouchou's time to shine.
...You lean against the wall in a deserted corridor inside the Live House after the performance.
...Sure. Sure, that's great.
You take care to keep your voice soft as you talk through the phone. Franchouchou has had an exhausting day, and you don't wish to disturb their rest.
Of course, no problem.
You hang up the call at last and let out a long sigh.
Well? Is the concert the day after tomorrow secured?
When did you appear...?
Answer me!
Yes, the organizer wishes to keep collaborating with Franchouchou, and they've proposed a new project.
What project?

They want Franchouchou to do a charity concert. It will be broadcast on TV, and part of the profit will be go into promoting Saga's tourism. That includes preserving traditional arts and crafts, conserving historical sites and heritage, funding businesses that sell local specialties and souvenirs, etc.
The ninja looks utterly stunned. You can see the darkened streaks of tears on his black face mask.
That's wonderful! All my effort in the last few days hasn't gone to waste...
Yeah, you also helped out big time tonight.
You knew?
It couldn't have been more obvious.
Tap-tap-tap...
A series of footsteps come from the other end of the corridor.
Commander? Are you there?
They've come looking for me. Perfect timing for them to thank—
Ninja?
The ninja has vanished without a trace.
There you are, Commander.
Yeah... Just here for some fresh air. All that screaming has left me a bit light-headed.
Everyone's waiting for you. Let's head back.
They're all looking forward to the after party.
Alright, let's go!
You start making for Franchouchou's dressing room, but you notice Sakura isn't keeping up after taking several steps.
She stands rooted to the spot by the window where you just had a conversation with the ninja, seemingly lost in her thoughts.
Sakura?
Oh, sorry, I spaced out.
What were you thinking about?
I was just thinking... it has been such a miraculous evening...
First, the door magically opened by itself when Tae and I randomly got stuck in the storeroom...
Yeah, a bottle of foundation also came flying in through the window when Junko and I were panicking in the dance studio.
It wasn't the right shade, but at least that got us out of our pickle...
Same here. We've been searching for the outfits the whole evening to no avail, then they just appeared magically by the door.
It really spooked Lily.
You smile as you gaze into the night outside the window.
Someone must be watching over Franchouchou.
